pages.title: Lashio
pages.extract: Lashio is a town of 131,000 people (2009) on a low mountain spur overlooking the valley of the Yaw River in Shan State, Myanmar.

pages.title: Les Trois Vallées
pages.description: The world's largest ski area. Located in Savoie, French Alps
pages.extract: Les Trois Vallées is in Savoie and is one of the large interlinked Alpine skiing areas of the French Alps.  It claims to be the largest ski area in the world with 600 km of interconnected slopes and 180 ski lifts, offering unparalleled skiing opportunities for all levels of skiers or boarders.

pages.title: Mexico City/Chapultepec
pages.extract: Chapultepec (Grasshopper Hill in Nahuatl, the language of the Aztecs) is Mexico City's principal park, "the green lung of the city". This hill has been important throughout the city's history as the perch of fortresses and palaces, and the manicured forest surrounding it now holds many of Mexico's greatest cultural treasures. The neighborhoods on either side are among the most affluent in the city.

pages.title: Newington (Connecticut)
pages.description: town in Hartford County, Connecticut, United States
pages.extract:
Newington is a town in central Connecticut, bordering Hartford, the state capital.  Although the center of Newington offers several shops, the shopping center of the town is located along the Berlin Turnpike, which has a slew of stores and restaurants.
There are some historical places to see in Newington, but it is mainly a normal suburban town.

pages.title: Skowhegan
pages.description: town in Somerset County, Maine, United States
pages.extract: Skowhegan is a village of 8,600 people (2020) on the banks of the Kennebec River in Maine.

pages.title: Grande Curitiba
pages.extract: Grande Curitiba is a region of the state of Paraná, in the South of Brazil. In 2015, it was home to 3½ million people.

pages.title: Salem (Ohio)
pages.extract: Salem is a city of 12,000 people (2019) in Columbiana County, Ohio. The city is an exurb of Youngstown, and is the commercial hub of northwestern Columbiana County, and home to Allegheny Wesleyan College and Kent State University at Salem.

pages.title: Thoddoo
pages.description: island in Alif Alif Atoll, Maldives
pages.extract: Thoddoo is an isolated inhabited island that administratively belongs to North Ari atoll, Maldives. It's quite large by Maldivian standards, it will take about an hour to circumvent it. In 2014, it had a population of about 1,500 people (including foreigners).

pages.extract: Pasighat is one of the oldest places in Arunachal Pradesh and an educational hub.

pages.title: Tewantin
pages.extract: Tewantin is a town in the Shire of Noosa, Queensland. Tewantin was the original settlement in the Noosa region and is one of its three major centres today. In 2021, Tewantin had a population of more than 11,000 people. This article also covers Noosaville and Noosa Heads.

pages.title: Colorado Trail
pages.extract: The Colorado Trail is a premier long-distance trail stretching 486 mi (782 km) from Denver to Durango. It traverses the stunning Rocky Mountains, passing through eight mountain ranges, seven national forests, and six wilderness areas. This itinerary provides a framework for thru-hiking or section-hiking this breathtaking and challenging trail.

pages.title: Tintin tourism
pages.description: series of 24 comic albums by Belgian cartoonist Georges Remi (Hergé‎)
pages.extract: Tintin tourism is travel inspired by The Adventures of Tintin, the comic series created by the Belgian artist Hergé. The series began in 1929 and ran for decades, with 24 albums that have been translated into dozens of languages. Over the course of the series the young reporter Tintin, his dog Snowy and companions such as Captain Haddock and Professor Calculus travel across Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas, and even to the Moon.
